'''Valen Korik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bounty hunter, he was legendary within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Mandalorians during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], but in violation of the [[Mandalorian-Sith Empire Alliance|Mandalorian-Imperial alliance]], he [[Death/Legends|killed]] two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and as a result, he and his men fled to the [[Dark Temple]], where they become possessed by the spirits within the structure. He was killed by Imperial spacers who had enter the temple.<ref name="TOR:PH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The target of the Heroic mission "Possessed Hunter" on Dromund Kaas, Valen Korik was cut along with the rest of the mission from the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. However, Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]] saw the mission restored to the game.<ref name="TOR:PH" />
